context: Grading a response that writes a chezmoi run script installing Homebrew packages only on first setup.

checklist.name: correct_prefix_used
checklist.description: Response uses the `run_once_before_` prefix (not bare `run_` or `once_` alone) on the script filename.

checklist.name: explains_content_hashing
checklist.description: Response correctly explains that `once_` re-run detection is based on hashing the script's content, not on elapsed time.

checklist.name: distinguishes_once_vs_onchange
checklist.description: Response distinguishes `run_once_` from `run_onchange_` and states when each is appropriate.

checklist.name: correct_prefix_ordering
checklist.description: Any multi-prefix filename shown uses correct ordering (`run_once_before_...`), not a scrambled order like `before_run_once_`.

checklist.name: no_external_runner_suggested
checklist.description: Response does not suggest a cron job or external script runner instead of chezmoi's own run-script mechanism.
